process_area.title: Recall Resolution, Reimbursement & Root Cause / CAPA

value_stream.name: Product Recall & Safety Corrective Action Management

fields.Participants: Finance/AP, Vendor Mgmt, Legal, Supply Chain

workflows.name: Vendor Reimbursement, Credit & Cost Recovery for Recalls

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logistics, destruction, communications, regulatory, and internal labor — by…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-escalate of "escalates disputes to Legal" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: contract indemnification clauses and documented cost ledger
Pain Points / Risks: - **Recovery risk**: Vendor disputes or delays reimbursement; mitigated by contract indemnification clauses and documented cost ledger
System Touchpoints: - AP credit/debit memo (links to W7/W100); recall cost ledger; vendor recovery aging (links to VS-67)

steps.activity: Finance/AP compiles recall cost ledger: refunds/credits issued, retrieval logistics, destruction, communications, regulatory, and internal labor — by vendor/SKU
Vendor Mgmt/Legal presents cost ledger to vendor under the corrective action agreement (W2998); negotiates credit memo, debit, or cash reimbursement
Finance/AP posts vendor credit/debit memo; reconciles to recall case; tracks recovery aging; escalates disputes to Legal

fields.Participants: Quality, Logistics, EHS, Records, Licensed Disposal Vendor
fields.Trigger: Recalled stock dispositioned for destruction (not returnable/salvageable)

workflows.name: Recalled Product Destruction, Recycling & Disposal Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics selects licensed destruction/disposal vendor" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-issue of "issues certificate of destruction with quantities and serial/lot evidence" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Records retains destruction certificates and evidence in recall audit file" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: licensed vendor, certificate of destruction, and serialization
Pain Points / Risks: - **Diversion risk**: Recalled product re-enters market via disposal chain; mitigated by licensed vendor, certificate of destruction, and serialization
System Touchpoints: - Disposal vendor record; certificate of destruction; inventory write-off (links to VS-05); EHS compliance (links to VS-24)

steps.activity: Quality/Logistics selects licensed destruction/disposal vendor; confirms method (incineration, crushing, certified recycling) appropriate to product and DENR/EHS rules (links to VS-24)
Disposal Vendor destroys/recycles stock; issues certificate of destruction with quantities and serial/lot evidence; EHS verifies hazardous-goods handling
Quality/Records retains destruction certificates and evidence in recall audit file; updates inventory write-off (W3022-equivalent) and removes quarantined stock

fields.Participants: Quality, Vendor Mgmt, Merchandising, Engineering/Technical, Product Safety

workflows.name: Recall Root Cause Analysis & CAPA (Corrective & Preventive Action)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "verify against DTI-BPS re-certification" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks CAPA to closure" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-498 (ensure controlled execution — Recall Resolution, Reimbursement & Root Cause / CAPA (PA-89.3).)
- operational: formal CAPA tracking and effectiveness verification
Pain Points / Risks: - **Recurrence risk**: Root cause not fully corrected; mitigated by formal CAPA tracking and effectiveness verification
System Touchpoints: - CAPA / non-conformance module (links to VS-31); vendor scorecard (links to VS-67)

steps.activity: Quality leads root cause analysis (5-Why / fishbone) with vendor/manufacturer and internal stakeholders; identifies design, process, supplier, or specification cause
Quality/Vendor Mgmt define CAPA: corrective (fix cause) and preventive (avoid recurrence) actions, owners, and deadlines; verify against DTI-BPS re-certification (W447)
Quality tracks CAPA to closure; verifies effectiveness; updates vendor scorecard (links to VS-67) and QA process controls

fields.Participants: Product Safety, Quality, Customer Service, Data Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitor incoming complaints/returns for the recalled SKU/lot and similar SKUs" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "verify CAPA effectiveness via targeted audits and field data" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports surveillance outcome to Recall Committee and regulator where required" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-498 (ensure controlled execution — Recall Resolution, Reimbursement & Root Cause / CAPA (PA-89.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Recurrence risk**: Recurrence missed due to alerting gaps; mitigated by automated SKU/lot complaint-rate alerts
System Touchpoints: - Complaint/return trend analytics (links to VS-28/VS-32); CAPA effectiveness tracker

steps.activity: Product Safety/Customer Service monitor incoming complaints/returns for the recalled SKU/lot and similar SKUs; watch for re-occurrence signals
Quality/Product Safety verify CAPA effectiveness via targeted audits and field data; confirms corrected product requalified (W447)
Product Safety reports surveillance outcome to Recall Committee and regulator where required; closes or re-opens recall

fields.Participants: Regulatory Officer, Product Safety, Legal, Quality
fields.Trigger: Effectiveness targets met and CAPA closed

workflows.name: Regulatory Close-Out Reporting (DTI-BPS / FDA) & Recall Termination

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-compile of "compiles close-out report" (replaces manual Step 1).
Controls: - CTL-498 (ensure controlled execution — Recall Resolution, Reimbursement & Root Cause / CAPA (PA-89.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Premature termination risk**: Closing before regulator acceptance; mitigated by formal regulator acknowledgment requirement
System Touchpoints: - Regulatory filing portal; recall case termination; listing/POS block release (links to VS-10)

steps.activity: Regulatory Officer compiles close-out report: scope, units recovered, effectiveness %, disposition, CAPA status; submits to DTI-BPS/FDA per their termination process
Legal/Regulatory obtains regulator acknowledgment/termination; lifts any PS/ICC mark suspension on corrected product; confirms relisting eligibility
Product Safety formally terminates recall in case system; releases residual quarantine; restores SKU/listing per corrected-product status

fields.Participants: Records Mgr, Product Safety, Legal, Compliance

workflows.name: Recall Records Retention, Documentation & Audit File

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logs, destruction certificates, CAPA, close-out" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate completeness and privileged-content handling" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Records Mgr files to tamper-evident repository" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-498 (ensure controlled execution — Recall Resolution, Reimbursement & Root Cause / CAPA (PA-89.3).)
- operational: closure checklist and tamper-evident archive
Pain Points / Risks: - **Audit-readiness risk**: Incomplete file undermines regulator/litigation defense; mitigated by closure checklist and tamper-evident archive
System Touchpoints: - Records/document management (links to VS-88); legal hold; retention scheduling

steps.activity: Records Mgr assembles recall audit file: decision records, regulator filings, notifications, retrieval/delivery logs, destruction certificates, CAPA, close-out
Legal/Compliance validate completeness and privileged-content handling; mark retention class (Consumer Act + BIR/SEC 10-year, product-liability statutes)
Records Mgr files to tamper-evident repository (links to VS-88); applies legal hold if litigation pending; supports future audit/litigation retrieval

fields.Trigger: Recall costs incurred and policy applicable
fields.Volume: Subset of recalls with product-recall/liability coverage

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "reviews product-recall / general-liability policy for coverage, deductibles,…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documentation, regulator filings, destruction certificates" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconciles to recall case" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-498 (ensure controlled execution — Recall Resolution, Reimbursement & Root Cause / CAPA (PA-89.3).)
- operational: policy notice-condition checklist and prompt notification
Pain Points / Risks: - **Coverage risk**: Late notice voids coverage; mitigated by policy notice-condition checklist and prompt notification
System Touchpoints: - Insurance policy/claim registry (links to W59/VS-26); recall cost ledger; finance recovery posting

steps.activity: Risk/Insurance reviews product-recall / general-liability policy for coverage, deductibles, and notice conditions; notifies insurer/broker within policy window
Finance/Risk compile claim evidence: cost ledger (W3009), incident documentation, regulator filings, destruction certificates
Risk/Insurance negotiates settlement with insurer; Finance posts recovery; reconciles to recall case; coordinates with vendor recovery (W3009) to avoid double-recovery

fields.Frequency: Per recall event + quarterly portfolio review
fields.Participants: Product Safety, Quality, Merchandising, Supply Chain, IT, Internal Audit

workflows.name: Recall Lessons Learned, Process & Quality System Improvement

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "Product Safety facilitates lessons-learned review" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "enterprise risk register" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-498 (ensure controlled execution — Recall Resolution, Reimbursement & Root Cause / CAPA (PA-89.3).)
- operational: tracked action items and playbook updates
Pain Points / Risks: - **Repeat-failure risk**: Lessons not embedded into process; mitigated by tracked action items and playbook updates
System Touchpoints: - Lessons-learned/action tracker; enterprise risk register (links to VS-21); training/L&D (links to VS-19)

steps.activity: Product Safety facilitates lessons-learned review: what worked, gaps (detection speed, traceability, reach), and systemic improvements
Stakeholders translate findings into process/system improvements: vendor onboarding QA gates, lot-traceability enhancements, notification automation, shelf-removal task rigor
Internal Audit/Product Safety track improvement actions to closure; update recall playbook and training; feed trends into enterprise risk register (links to VS-21)
